name: flocon
description: Connects your AI agent to the Flocon Desktop MCP server to debug your mobile app (timeline, crashes, network calls, mocks and bad network, files, analytics, databases, preferences, feature flags, deeplinks, dashboards, tables, images, accessibility, WebView, screenshots and recordings), and sets Flocon up or migrates it in Android, KMP, iOS and Flutter projects

interface.shortDescription: Debug your mobile app with Flocon
interface.longDescription: Debug your mobile app through Flocon Desktop: read the timeline of what the app did and its crashes, inspect, mock and slow down its network calls, read its files, analytics events, databases, preferences, feature flags, dashboards and tables, check its images, accessibility and WebView events, open deeplinks, take screenshots and screen recordings. Also sets Flocon up or migrates it in Android, KMP, iOS and Flutter projects. Flocon Desktop must be running.
defaultPrompt: What happened in my app right before the last crash?
Make the login call return a 500 so I can check the error screen
Check in the database that the user I just created is saved correctly
